description: Design reference from the Signal Flow prototype (Claude Design export, inline styles). The React version is not built yet, so rebuild this structure with the listed Carbon components and --at-* tokens; do not copy the prototype markup, which fails validate_page. One reviewed step of the requirements writer (8 fixed steps, in order). States: pending, thinking, review, approved. In review the reasoning is editable; editing marks the step as needing re-approval. Shows Evidence (theme Tags), 'Considered and rejected' alternatives, Approve, and 'Redo with instructions' (Modal with a TextArea). Brief output builds as steps 1 to 3 are approved. Publish is enabled only when every step is approved (the API returns 409 otherwise).
